item.title: EplayerX 1.2.56
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改进 Emby 播放版本选择。播放器会补全当前影片或剧集的可用版本，并在同一服务器内按文件大小排列。 - 编辑 Emby 服务器时，即使关闭线路同步，也可以修改主线路名称。仅修改线路名称时会保留现有登录状态。 - 改进部分 H.264 隔行视频的播放兼容性，并修复取消网络播放时可能卡在连接或读取的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved Emby version selection. The player shows available versions of the current movie or episode and sorts versions from the same server by file size. - You can rename an Emby server’s primary route with route syncing turned off. Renaming the route keeps your existing sign-in. - Improved playback compatibility with some interlaced H.264 videos and fixed a stall that could occur when canceling a network connection or read.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
